title: SKY-001: the first engineering world model?
label: NEW IN AI

lines.text: Meghana, stop! [1] A new AI designs a part in four seconds!

lines.text: Four seconds? This one hub took me three hours!

lines.text: It's Sky zero zero one. [1] It says fifty-one times faster than G P T six Astra, and a hundred and fifty times cheaper!

lines.text: It says it imagines the shape first: that's the world model. [1] Then it splits it into parts and draws each one like you do: [2] sketch, stretch, cut. [3] And it's more accurate than all of them!
